Every year from 2013 through 2025 has date coverage from January 1 through December 31 and a distinct crash date for every calendar day, so none of the annual percentages is based on a date-partial year. Keep all in-period rows in the within-year denominators, group by year and weekday, and disclose the out-of-period exclusions and that shares are crash-record composition, not risk adjusted for exposure.
